resources.string: Desktop Chromium for Linux, running inside this app. The phone screen is the Linux display.
Off by default. When on, Linux apps (e.g. Chromium) hear this phone\'s microphone. Only this switch can turn it on; the genie cannot. Turns off when the session ends. Nothing is recorded to disk.
Allow microphone in background (off: the mic pauses when you leave LinuxDesk, so other apps can record)
Microphone on · Linux can hear this phone
Microphone permission was not granted, so the microphone stays off.

Off by default. When on, web pages in Linux Chromium can pick any of this phone\'s cameras (listed as \"Phone back/front … mm\"). A camera only turns on while a page uses it; turning this off cuts every page off at once. Only this switch can turn it on; the genie cannot. Turns off when the session ends.
Camera permission was not granted, so the phone camera stays off.
Camera privacy: relay-only (web pages never see the camera address; a little slower)
Linux desktop session is running (X server + Chromium)
Show or hide keyboard (long-press for menu)

Legacy drawing (try this if the screen stays black)
Open Chrome at Start (off = the desktop only; open Chrome from the dock or Restart browser)

Allow GPU in Chromium (usually no effect inside PRoot)
Sound: play Linux audio on this phone (switches at once, no restart)
Smoother sound: bigger buffer, fewer clicks, ~0.15 s more delay (recommendation, off)

One-time setup (Android 12+): Chromium uses many processes, and Android kills apps with more than 32 child processes. Developer options → \"Disable child process restrictions\" turns this off. From a PC you can instead run: adb shell settings put global settings_enable_monitor_phantom_procs false
Enable Developer options first (Settings → About phone → tap Build number 7 times).
Chromium runs with --no-sandbox, because Android does not allow the sandbox it needs. Do not use it for banking or other sensitive accounts.
